title: FreedomCore Atlas Global Ticker Collisions v1

columns.name: bare_ticker
columns.description: Uppercase bare ticker shared by two or more distinct instruments

columns.name: collision_group_size
columns.description: Number of distinct Atlas listings sharing this bare ticker

columns.name: group_scope
columns.description: Asset-class mix of the collision group (equity_only, equity_and_crypto, crypto_only, includes_benchmark)

columns.name: listing_key
columns.description: Canonical exchange- or namespace-qualified primary key (EXCHANGE:TICKER, CRYPTO:SYMBOL, COINGECKO:ID)

columns.name: name
columns.description: Verified instrument or issuer display name

columns.name: asset_class
columns.description: Instrument class (equity, crypto, index, commodity, fx)

columns.name: country_code
columns.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (GL for global crypto/benchmarks)

columns.name: profile_url
columns.description: Live verified HTTP 200 canonical Atlas profile URL (empty if non-200)

columns.name: profile_http_status
columns.description: HTTP status observed on origin during dataset build verification

columns.name: sec_cik
columns.description: 10-digit zero-padded SEC EDGAR CIK string where applicable

columns.name: coingecko_id
columns.description: CoinGecko identifier for crypto assets where applicable

columns.name: quote_state
columns.description: Session-verified price freshness state from atlas-symbol-coverage v4

columns.name: chart_bars
columns.description: Count of verified daily OHLC bars

columns.name: snapshot_date
columns.description: UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the source symbol-coverage release
